answer: At each drift length, every dialogue contributes exactly one simple, one medium, and one hard response, so the three persuasion cells have equal denominators. The pooled probe-level rate is therefore \((L_{\text{simple}}+L_{\text{medium}}+L_{\text{hard}})/3\), assuming no missing calls.
